name: Production of Audio Albums of songs on Patriotism & National Integration
benefit:
##### ***Financial Support***
Tiatr Academy of Goa will give financial support as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for the production of the Album.
##### ***Distribution Channel***
Tiatr Academy of Goa will distribute 300 copies to schools & groups which participate in its various competitions and may also offer them to other schools, groups, individuals, etc. who are interested in promoting Pa
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a tiatr artiste (commercial as well as non-commercial). - The applicant must submit a typed copy of lyrics of songs to Tiatr Academy of Goa along with the application form. - The applicant must obtain approval of lyrics from the Recommendation Committee appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must receive official letter of acceptance from Tiatr Academy of Goa before production. - The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the lyrics of songs which may hurt the sentiments of anybody. ##### ***Album Content Requirements*** - The audio album must include at least 10 songs of Patriotism & National Integration. - The album should not have solo songs only. - 50% of the songs must be group songs and children's songs. - Melody and musical arrangement must be appropriate to the content of the song. - The applicant will have to give 300 copies of Audio albums to Tiatr Academy of Goa. ##### ***Quality Control Process*** - Lyrics will be scrutinized by the Recommendation Committee. - Committee will be free to advise the lyricists to improve the quality of lyrics. - Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disapprove the lyrics as per the opinion given by Recommendation Committee.
